articles.title: This ‘anti-vampiric’ grave was double guarded against the undead
articles.snippet: A sickle across the throat and a padlock on her toe were meant to keep a 17th-century teen girl from resurrecting from the grave.
articles.summary: A 17th-century teenage girl was buried with a sickle across her throat and a padlock on her toe to stop her from coming back from the dead. These items were used as double guards against the undead.
